metadata.question: Did the rate of cropland expansion slow in Africa from 2016-2019 compared to 2004-2007?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collection: MODIS/061/MCD12Q1 (annual land cover, 2001–2023). Fallback: MODIS/006/MCD12Q1.
- Years: 2004, 2007, 2016, 2019.
- Location: Africa (USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017 with wld_rgn contains 'Africa').

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- No cloud masking; using land cover classification. Generate cropland mask from IGBP classes: 12 (Croplands) and 14 (Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaics).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection presence for all years; if missing, try fallback; if still missing → C1.
- Compute valid pixel counts for each year; if any year count==0 → C2.
- If any area result is null/NaN → C3.
- Compare average annual net change (Mha/yr) 2004→2007 vs 2016→2019; if later rate < earlier rate → A, else B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const yearsNeeded = [2004, 2007, 2016, 2019];
    const africaFC = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.stringContains('wld_rgn', 'Africa'));
    const africa = africaFC.geometry();

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    const col061 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD12Q1');
    const col006 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1');

    async function hasAllYears(col, years) {
      const sizes = await Promise.all(years.map(y =>
        new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          col.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y, y, 'year')).size().getInfo((v, e) => {
            if (e) reject(e); else resolve(v);
          });
        })
      ));
      return sizes.every(s => s > 0) ? sizes : null;
    }

    let chosenCol = null;
    let imgCounts = null;
    try {
      const s061 = await hasAllYears(col061, yearsNeeded);
      if (s061) { chosenCol = col061; imgCounts = s061; }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (!chosenCol) {
      try {
        const s006 = await hasAllYears(col006, yearsNeeded);
        if (s006) { chosenCol = col006; imgCounts = s006; }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    if (!chosenCol) {
      console.log('Images found: 2004: 0; 2007: 0; 2016: 0; 2019: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const datasetName = chosenCol.getInfo().id;
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetName}`);
    console.log(`Images found: 2004: ${imgCounts[0]}; 2007: ${imgCounts[1]}; 2016: ${imgCounts[2]}; 2019: ${imgCounts[3]}`);

    function getYearImage(col, year) {
      return ee.Image(col.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')).first());
    }

    const imgs = {
      2004: getYearImage(chosenCol, 2004),
      2007: getYearImage(chosenCol, 2007),
      2016: getYearImage(chosenCol, 2016),
      2019: getYearImage(chosenCol, 2019),
    };

    const lcBand = 'LC_Type1';
    function croplandMask(img) {
      // IGBP class 12 (Croplands), 14 (Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaics)
      const lc = img.select(lcBand);
      return lc.remap([12, 14], [1, 1]).eq(1);
    }

    // 3. Processing: valid pixel counts and cropland areas
    function yearStats(img) {
      const maskCrop = croplandMask(img);
      const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e10).updateMask(maskCrop); // Mha per pixel
      const lc = img.select(lcBand);
      const countDict = lc.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: africa,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 2e13,
        bestEffort: true
      });
      const areaDict = areaImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: africa,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 2e13,
        bestEffort: true
      });
      return ee.Dictionary({
        valid_px: ee.Number(countDict.get(lcBand)),
        area_mha: ee.Number(areaDict.get('area'))
      });
    }

    const statsDict = ee.Dictionary({
      'px2004': yearStats(imgs[2004]).get('valid_px'),
      'px2007': yearStats(imgs[2007]).get('valid_px'),
      'px2016': yearStats(imgs[2016]).get('valid_px'),
      'px2019': yearStats(imgs[2019]).get('valid_px'),
      'a2004': yearStats(imgs[2004]).get('area_mha'),
      'a2007': yearStats(imgs[2007]).get('area_mha'),
      'a2016': yearStats(imgs[2016]).get('area_mha'),
      'a2019': yearStats(imgs[2019]).get('area_mha'),
    });

    const results = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      statsDict.getInfo((v, e) => e ? reject(e) : resolve(v));
    });

    // 4. Validation for C2/C3
    const px2004 = results.px2004, px2007 = results.px2007, px2016 = results.px2016, px2019 = results.px2019;
    if ([px2004, px2007, px2016, px2019].some(v => v === 0)) {
      console.log(`Valid px (2004/2007/2016/2019): ${px2004}/${px2007}/${px2016}/${px2019}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const a2004 = results.a2004, a2007 = results.a2007, a2016 = results.a2016, a2019 = results.a2019;
    const anyNull = [a2004, a2007, a2016, a2019].some(v => v === null || v === undefined || Number.isNaN(v));
    if (anyNull) {
      console.log(`Valid px (2004/2007/2016/2019): ${px2004}/${px2007}/${px2016}/${px2019}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Calculation: net changes and rates
    const d0407 = a2007 - a2004;
    const r0407 = d0407 / 3.0;
    const d1619 = a2019 - a2016;
    const r1619 = d1619 / 3.0;

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Valid px (2004/2007/2016/2019): ${px2004}/${px2007}/${px2016}/${px2019}`);
    console.log(`Cropland area (Mha) 2004/2007: ${a2004.toFixed(2)} / ${a2007.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Cropland area (Mha) 2016/2019: ${a2016.toFixed(2)} / ${a2019.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Net Δ 2004→2007: ${d0407.toFixed(2)} Mha (${r0407.toFixed(2)} Mha/yr)`);
    console.log(`Net Δ 2016→2019: ${d1619.toFixed(2)} Mha (${r1619.toFixed(2)} Mha/yr)`);

    // 6. Final Answer
    const slowed = r1619 < r0407;
    console.log(`Slowed? ${slowed ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);
    console.log(slowed ? 'A' : 'B');

  } catch (err) {
    // If any unexpected error occurs (e.g., band names, memory, API), return D.
    try { console.log('D'); } catch (_) {}
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
